name: bitmovin-observability-collector-integration
description: Portable Bitmovin Observability collector setup skill packaged for Codex as a local plugin.

interface.shortDescription: Integrate the Bitmovin Analytics collector into any player on any platform
interface.longDescription: Integrates the Bitmovin Observability (Analytics) collector into any video player on any platform: Web, Android/Fire TV, iOS/tvOS/visionOS, and Roku, for both the Bitmovin Player and third-party engines (HLS.js, Shaka, Video.js, HTML5, ExoPlayer, Media3, AVPlayer, THEOplayer, CAFv3). Covers the managed attach/detach lifecycle third-party players require, verification of incoming data, and why analytics data may be missing, empty, or wrong after integrating.
defaultPrompt: Set up the Bitmovin Analytics collector in this app
Add analytics to my Shaka player
Why is my Bitmovin analytics data empty after integrating?
